description: Fetches section data from SEC 10-K filings for stocks.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key (10 digits, zero-padded).

sort.description: A comma separated list of sort columns. For each column, append '.asc' or '.desc' to specify the sort direction. The sort column defaults to 'period_end' if not specified. The sort order defaults to 'desc' if not specified.

limit.description: Limit the maximum number of results returned. Defaults to '10' if not specified. The maximum allowed limit is '100'.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol for the company.

cik.gte.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value.

cik.lte.description: Filter less than or equal to the value.

section.description: Standardized section identifier from the filing (e.g. 'business', 'risk_factors', etc.).

cik.any_of.description: Filter equal to any of the values. Multiple values can be specified by using a comma separated list.

period_end.description: Period end date that the filing relates to (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

ticker.gte.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value.

ticker.lte.description: Filter less than or equal to the value.

filing_date.description: Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

period_end.gt.description: Filter greater than the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

period_end.lt.description: Filter less than the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

ticker.any_of.description: Filter equal to any of the values. Multiple values can be specified by using a comma separated list.

filing_date.gt.description: Filter greater than the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

filing_date.lt.description: Filter less than the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

period_end.gte.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

period_end.lte.description: Filter less than or equal to the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

section.any_of.description: Filter equal to any of the values. Multiple values can be specified by using a comma separated list.

filing_date.gte.description: Filter greater than or equal to the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.

filing_date.lte.description: Filter less than or equal to the value. Value must be formatted 'yyyy-mm-dd'.
